The shift at 4.43 ppm could be indicative of a proton on a carbon adjacent to an electronegative atom, such as oxygen. To further refine the structure, I will obtain the IR spectra to identify any functional groups present.</thought>

The peaks around 3000 cm⁻¹ indicate C-H stretching, typical for alkenes or aromatics. The peak at 1712 cm⁻¹ is indicative of a carbonyl group (C=O), suggesting the presence of a ketone or aldehyde. Given the NMR and IR data, the molecule likely contains an aromatic ring, an alcohol, and a carbonyl group.
